simple.summary: עָגַן (ʻâgan) means to debar , i.e. from marriage First listed occurrence: Ruth 1 13.

definitions.full: H5702. agan [ עָגַן ] verb Niph`al shut oneself in or off (Late Hebrew id. , Passive participle restrained (especially from marriage), also עוֺגִין anchor ; עֲגַן ᵑ7 be imprisoned); — Imperfect 2feminine plural לְאִישׁ הֱיוֺת לְבִלְתִּי תֵּעָגֵ֫נָה Ruth 1:13 would ye shut yourselves off, so as not to belong to a man ? עגר (√ of following, meaning dubious; conjectures in Meier Wurzel WB 38 Lag BN 59 ; on Greek ἀγορ compare Lewy Fremdw. 8 ).
